d:
Jalvayu parivartan aur prajatiyon ke khatm hone jaisi samasyaon ka aksar yahi aasan hal bataya jata hai ki aur per lagao. par ye tariqa sachmuch kitna asardar hai?
Janglon ki kataee barh rahi hai aur CO₂ utsarjan rikord star par hai. paryavran ki tabahi se laraee men per lagana aksar ramban ki tarah pesh kiya jata hai. neta, NGO aur bahurashtriy kanpniyan- sab isi aasan aur saste hal ki or barh rahe hain.
